id: E0 + Stage-2 geometry verification + MINT-v0.0 (development, block T)
written: 2026-10-23, before any data of this run was downloaded

data.split: OPV2V validate, block T only (D-25); no calibration claims; no test or calibration scenarios

detector: released AttFuse PointPillars, proj_first (D-13b), MINT fuse_scale (D-20), seeded shuffle (D-23)

harm_label.L_u: #FP + #FN + 0.5*sum_TP(1-IoU), BEV IoU>=0.5, centres in tile u (6.4 m)
harm_label.approximation: Y-(i) = sender excluded everywhere, restricted to u (differs from Y-(i,u) only through NMS across tile borders)

attacks.attacker: agent index 1 (first non-ego CAV in OpenCOOD order), every frame with >=2 agents

families.spoof_feat: A-F2a: copy attacker's own feature patch of a GT object it sees (>=20 pts) to a uniformly random GT-free location (|x|<=60, |y|<=35 m, >=6 m from receiver, patch+3 m clear of GT centres), coarse-cell aligned
families.remove_feat: A-F2b: overwrite the patch of a random seen GT object with a random free background patch
families.shift_feat: A-F5: remove_feat then paste the original patch 3.2 m away along a random axis
families.spoof_pts: A-R2-lite: copy attacker's points on a seen GT object (>=50 pts) to a random free location (>=6 m from GT centres and receiver), append to attacker pillars, re-encode

attacks.random_placement: all four families; no visibility-aware placement in E0

policies.oracle_all: gate (i,u) for every sender i and tile u with D>0.5 (labels from GT)
policies.vis_oracle_all: oracle_all restricted to units whose every effect box has >=3 receiver rays (SUP+TRAV, standard count) and is not a self box
policies.vis_oracle_attacker: vis_oracle_all restricted to the attacker's units
policies.composition: exact tile-wise composition of per-subset decodes; verified against real masked passes every 10th clean frame

metrics.AP: OpenCOOD default AP at IoU 0.3/0.5/0.7, pooled over the 3 scenarios; primary AP@0.7

decision_rule.primary: vis_oracle_attacker recovery at AP@0.7, mean over the four families; < 0.30 -> STOP and recommend re-scoping
decision_rule.also_reported: per family; AP@0.5; all-sender versions; clean-data oracle headroom
decision_rule.degenerate: families whose attack loss at AP@0.7 is < 0.005 are reported but excluded from the mean (recovery undefined)

ground_test.question: is a per-frame receiver-only ground estimate required?
ground_test.data: empty synthetic vehicle boxes (null) vs GT boxes, >=3 receiver rays
ground_test.required_if: standard-count median support ratio of null boxes > 0.20 in any range bin (0-20, 20-40, 40-70 m), or the ground-aware count raises AUROC(GT vs null support ratio) by >= 0.05
ground_test.then: MINT-v0.0 uses the ground-aware count; otherwise the standard count

self_box_test.D-24: exactly one GT box contains the receiver origin in BEV per frame, with centre <= 2 m; report frames violating this and disagreement with the old 1.5 m proxy

mint_v0_0.evidence: support ratio s = SUP/(SUP+TRAV) per effect box (count variant per ground_test)
mint_v0_0.status: KNOWN iff every effect of the unit has >=3 rays and is not a self box; else UNKNOWN -> keep
mint_v0_0.raw scores: per effect h_keep - h_remove: ADD 1-2s+, REMOVE 2s- - 1, SHIFT s- - s+; unit score = sum over effects
mint_v0_0.gate: remove sender i in tile u iff KNOWN and unit score > theta; headline theta = 0 (fixed, not tuned); sweep reported
mint_v0_0.naming: raw scores are NOT probabilities; no calibration in this step
